Table III (2409.15692v2) columns 'w/o TerProg' and 'w/o T-RCr' are interleaved in the extracted text; values were assigned by header column order.
Heightmap grid size 32 x 16 cells is derived from the stated range and resolution, not stated in the paper.

All values marked ABSENT (PPO hyperparameters, loss weights, p_max/T_start/T_end, edge slope threshold, depth resolution and randomization in 2409.15692v2, PD gains, H_t^f cell count) must be chosen by us in the plan stage; the paper gives no guidance.
Paper text was treated as untrusted evidence only; no claim of scientific equivalence between the two papers is made beyond textual comparison.
Mapping notes to Go2 EDU, D435i + L1, Isaac Lab 2.3.2, and 2x RTX 5080 are our inferences and are not supported by either paper.
